notes.title: Haiki released! Halloween Special activated
notes.content:
[h2]Haiki released![/h2]
We are very happy to say that Haiki is finally released. We want to thank everyone supporting us on this long journey!

[h2]Halloween Special[/h2]
And it is just before Halloween. So we have added a nice seasonal feature that is only available between now and Nov. 5th.
Go smash the pumpkins where you find them as a bit of an extra challenge!

Have fun!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello Guys,

It’s certainly about time for a small developer update. Sorry for the radio silence for so long; we must have lost our heads in the madness ;) 

2021 will be an exciting year for Haiki as he continues the search for his lost body. If you’ve already tried the demo during one of our recent events, then you’ll know what the game is all about: fast-paced, limb-free platforming that just feels good. 

[b]MINOR SETBACK[/b]
The pandemic has impacted development just a little, but that’s to be expected, and we’ve not slowed up. In the face of new and unexpected challenges, coming up with new ideas for some of the latter levels cannot have been easy. But that’s exactly what Richard has been doing over the most recent few weeks. Right now, he’s working on several harder chapters that are, unsurprisingly, a bit more demanding from a design perspective. 

Creating levels that are fun but also unique, responsive, and bug-free is obviously a top priority. Haiki can be difficult but, at the same time, incredibly rewarding when played right.

[b]ALMOST THERE[/b]
With 23 levels left, we’re nearly three-quarters of the way there! Most of the remaining work is from the third major area. Richard also teased a “really good idea” for the final part of the game—an excellent finisher. Check out our [url=https://twitter.com/haiki_game]social media[/url] to see more.

The story planning itself is complete, so we now have a clearer picture of where Haiki is going. The cutscenes are another big part of Haiki that are still currently under wraps for now. More on that soon! 

On the audio side of things, the game’s sound is in production and should be ready to share with you in a matter of weeks. Join our [url=discord.com/invite/26nVH2r]Discord[/url] to be the first to hear it. 

[b]MAJOR IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
Over the past few weeks, Haiki has seen some major additions and improvements:
[list]
[*] New and exciting levels have made their way into the game.
[*] Our bodiless hero’s motion trail has reached its final form.
[*] Spikes have received a little extra highlight to help players avoid confusing them with platforms. (You’ll still die a lot, albeit for different reasons).
[/list]

2021 is looking up for our brave, decapitated hero. Keep an eye—and a head—out for more updates and announcements very soon! 

Stay safe,
Alex and George

notes.title: MAG 2020 - Haiki: New demo available
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Speedrunners! [/h2]

To celebrate the start of the Steam Autumn sale, we are once again making the Haiki demo available on our Steam page for a limited time. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395270/Haiki/]Download it here on the game page[/url]				

[h2][b]This time around, however, there are some changes![/b]
[/h2][list]
[*] The demo has a different level selection from the previous one. Show us your skills!
[*] The new demo has updated sounds and new VFX!
[*] The user interface went through a substantial overhaul.
[/list]
[b]If you’ve played a previous version[/b] of the demo before, during another event, do please check it out again with the new levels.

Let us know what you think in the Steam Community or on social media: 
[url=https://twitter.com/haiki_game]Haiki Game Twitter[/url]
[url=https://discord.haiki-game.com]Haiki on Discord[/url]


[h3]HAIKI IS AT MAG 2020[/h3]

The good news doesn’t end here, Haiki is at MAG 2020! 
The MAG online community convention unites those from the field of cosplay, games, fashion and art and will be presented entirely online from 27th – 29th November. 

Take a look at the event, and join us for our livestream events found [url=https://mag-online.super-crowd.com/]here[/url]. 

We’re not alone, we’re also joined by other excellent Application Systems Heidelberg games:

[b]Growbot[/b] - A point-and-click adventure about a robot saving her home from a dark crystalline force. Set upon a biopunk space station bursting with fantastic plants and aliens.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661680/Growbot/]Store page here[/url]

[b]Ghost on the Shore[/b] - An exploration game about emotional ties that transcend even death. Riley is faced with a headstrong ghost, urging her on an adventure across atmospheric shores, uncovering the island's tragic secret. Choices in dialogue shape the bond between the two, ultimately deciding Riley's fate.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211930/Ghost_on_the_Shore/]Store page here[/url]

[b]Rosewater[/b] - a thrilling Western adventure set in an alternate 19th century. Harley Leger and her ragtag posse embark on a harrowing journey across Western Vespuccia, encountering bandits, rebels, visionaries, eccentrics, and many more friends and foes on their quest for fame and riches.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226670/Rosewater/]Store page here[/url]

[b]Mutropolis[/b] -  is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037120/Mutropolis/]Store page here[/url]


[h3]About Haiki[/h3]				
Haiki is the BRUTAL precision platformer where decapitation is just the beginning! Dive head-first into four worlds of colour-switching, laser-dodging, lightning-fast action. Haiki is the platformer where you don't need a body to get ahead.				
				
[h3]Haiki Dev insights & gameplay[/h3]				
Richard will have a chat with Volker (ASHGAMES). We introduce the developer and talk about the inspiration and ideas behind Haiki. 
We show the game concept and play the game a bit. A lot of behind the scenes content is waiting for you. 
				
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395270/Haiki/]Watch the broadcast on the store page[/url]
